title: Sync Rate Check: Evangelion True or False
description: Ten statements on the 1995 series: studios, broadcast, setting, songs and awards. Some are one detail off, so read closely.

questions.question: The 1995 series was animated by Gainax together with Tatsunoko Production, with Hideaki Anno in the director's chair.
Evangelion aired as a single season of 26 episodes on TV Asahi, starting on October 4, 1995 and finishing on March 27, 1996.
Evangelion aired as a single season of 26 episodes on TV Tokyo, starting on October 4, 1995 and finishing on March 27, 1996.
The 1995 series was animated by Gainax together with Madhouse, with Hideaki Anno in the director's chair.
The year is 2035 and the stage is Tokyo-3, a heavily defended city built in the wake of a catastrophe that hit the planet 15 years earlier.
The year is 2015 and the stage is Tokyo-3, a heavily defended city built in the wake of a catastrophe that hit the planet 15 years earlier.
The opening theme, A Cruel Angel's Thesis, is sung by Claire Littley, and it took an Animage award for best song in 1996.
The opening theme, A Cruel Angel's Thesis, is sung by Yoko Takahashi, and it took an Animage award for best song in 1996.
Animage readers voted Evangelion their top Best Loved Series at the Anime Grand Prix in 1996, and again in 1997.
Netflix brought the 1995 series to a global audience from June 21, 2019, and the closing song Fly Me to the Moon is kept in every country.

notes: Statements restate arc 0 fact texts (002, 003, 004, 005, 011, 012); each false one changes a single detail (a studio, a channel, a year, a singer or the song claim).
